title: Sudden Starlink Restrictions Hamper Ukraine Just as Russia Escalates
summary: Kyiv has found itself increasingly vulnerable. A huge attack cut power to 600,000 people there, and a Pentagon-funded satellite program appeared to be curbed without warning.
